question: Which of the following ratios is the greatest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Compare ratios to 1/2 (50%) by checking if the numerator is greater than half of the denominator.

29 : 57 → Half of 57 is 28.5 → 29 > 28.5 (Ratio is more than 50%)

The ratios 22 : 82, 23 : 75, and 31 : 85 all have numerators that are less than half of their respective denominators (Ratios are less than 50%).

Since only the first ratio crosses the 50% mark, it is visibly the greatest.

**∴ The correct answer is 29 : 57.**
